code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows mild hypoxemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and mild hypoglycemia. There is neutropenia, lymphopenia, monocytosis, eosinophilia, and basophilia. Renal function is impaired (elevated creatinine), with mild metabolic acidosis (low CO₂). Liver enzymes are mostly normal except for elevated alkaline phosphatase. Ferritin and CRP are elevated, suggesting inflammation. INR is prolonged. Findings may indicate systemic inflammation or infection, possible bone marrow suppression, and renal dysfunction; clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
